name: HW 2: Requirements & Use Cases
description:
Use the parking garage system from Lecture 7. Submit one PDF using the v2 template.

  1. Q1 (20 pts) Stakeholder list for the parking garage.
  2. Q2 (25 pts) Five functional requirements.
  3. Q3 (25 pts) Using the parking garage system introduced in Lecture 7, write three functional and three non-functional requirements. For each requirement, state the stakeholder need it traces to and describe how it would be verified. Use the v2 template.
  4. Q4 (30 pts) Use case diagram (SysML).

Late: 10% per day, max 3 days.
